content:
Dear FreshCart Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Butcher / Meat Counter Assistant position at your Zagreb-Jarun store. I have completed butcher training and bring four years of meat-counter customer service experience, alongside practical butchery and meat preparation work.

In my work at Mesnica Kod Ante, I prepare fresh sausages—around 40 kg a week in the busy season—and prepare whole lambs and suckling pigs for events. I also rotate cold-room stock each morning using FIFO. My meat-counter experience includes weighing and pricing orders, operating the till, wrapping customer orders and keeping equipment and work areas clean. I have basic HACCP knowledge and take care with hygiene routines.

FreshCart’s emphasis on knowledgeable, friendly counter service and honest advice fits the kind of careful, customer-focused work I value. I would welcome the opportunity to bring my butchery training, practical experience and customer service skills to your team.

Kind regards,
Tomislav Mesarić

critique.content_quality_feedback: The cover letter is concise, professional, and well targeted to the Butcher / Meat Counter Assistant role. It clearly presents completed butcher training, four years of meat-counter customer service, fresh sausage production, whole-animal preparation, FIFO stock rotation, till operation, order handling, cleaning, and basic HACCP knowledge. The examples are specific and credible, particularly the approximately 40 kg of sausage per week and preparation of lambs and suckling pigs for events. The tone fits FreshCart’s emphasis on knowledgeable service, hygiene, reliability, and product quality. A minor limitation is that it does not mention temperature-recording experience or make the connection to the job’s packaging and hygiene-check duties as explicitly as it could.
critique.ats_compatibility_feedback: The letter uses ATS-friendly plain text, standard headings are not necessary for this short document, and the wording includes several relevant keywords: butcher training, meat-counter customer service, fresh sausages, FIFO, weighing and pricing, till, HACCP, hygiene, and cleaning. AI screening probability is high because the letter directly links the candidate’s experience to the role and avoids unsupported claims. For slightly stronger keyword alignment, it could use the job description’s terms ‘package fresh meat’ and ‘record temperature and hygiene checks,’ but only in ways supported by the candidate’s information. It correctly does not claim a forklift licence or supermarket self-service packing experience.
critique.job_alignment_feedback: The document strongly matches both must-have requirements: completed butcher training and more than two years of meat-counter experience, plus HACCP knowledge. It also aligns well with the role’s practical duties through meat preparation, customer orders, FIFO rotation, equipment cleaning, and sausage production. The customer-focused paragraph fits FreshCart’s ‘Ask the counter’ promise and values of friendly service, honest advice, and pride in good work. The candidate’s material shows a gap for the nice-to-have forklift licence; this is not a document defect and should not be presented as a qualification. The material also indicates no supermarket, tray-sealer, or self-service labelling-scale experience, but the letter appropriately does not claim those skills.
critique.improvement_instructions:
MINOR ENHANCEMENT — In the second paragraph, after the sentence ending ‘keeping equipment and work areas clean,’ add a concise sentence supported by the candidate’s portfolio: ‘I have also recorded temperature readings during a dry-ageing trial and maintained weight-loss records.’ This would more directly align the letter with FreshCart’s requirement to record temperature and hygiene checks without overstating HACCP expertise.

MINOR ENHANCEMENT — In the same paragraph, change ‘wrapping customer orders’ to ‘packaging customer meat orders in paper after weighing and pricing.’ This uses the job’s packaging terminology while remaining accurate and avoiding any implication of tray-sealer or self-service packing experience.

requirements.requirement: Completed butcher training or ≥ 2 years at a meat counter
requirements.quote: I have completed butcher training and bring four years of meat-counter customer service experience
I have basic HACCP knowledge and take care with hygiene routines.
